d: Chhath Puja 2026 : lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ka aaj dusra din hai aur aaj kharna manaya ja raha hai... kharna ko lekar patna samet bihar ke bajaron men raunak dekhne ko mil rahi hai... patna ki phal mandi men chhath vratiyon aur shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umar rahi hai... log puja ke lie phal aur any jaruri saman ki kharidari kar rahe hain... kharna ke din vrati pure din upvas rakhte hain... sham ko puja-archana ke bad gur ki khir, roti aur phal ka prasad grahan kiya jata hai... iske bad karib 36 ghante ka nirjala vrat shuru hota hai
